senses: to come to know, discover, know
lex:
γνωρίζω
(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for ידע hi. ;]
__1. as most commonly in cl., to come to know, discover, know: Php.1:22 (but cf. R, mg.).
__2. to make known: with accusative, Rom.9:22, 23; with accusative of thing(s) da.t. of person(s), Luk.2:15, Jhn.15:15 17:26, Act.2:28" (LXX), 1Co.15:1, 2Co.8:1, Gal.1:11, Eph.1:9 6:19, 21 Col.4:7, 9 2Pe.1:16; with dative, before ὅτι, 1Co.12:3; before τί, Col.1:27; περί, Luk.2:17. Pass., Act.7:13, Rom.16:26, Eph.3:3, 6 10, Php.4:6 (Cremer, 677; cf. ἀνα-, δια-γνωρίζω).
†

strongs.def: to make known; subjectively, to know
strongs.kjv: certify, declare, make known, give to understand, do to wit, wot
